center.locator: centroid of the reactor-building dome (OSM way 608881797)
center.note: Map centre only: centroid of the drawn reactor building; not a claim about any structure.

name: Leibstadt — reactor building and the CONUS+ position
notes: Correction: the earlier map drew an unrelated building (way 567961020) as the reactor building; the reactor building is the dome-roofed part (way 608881797) at the plant's OSM generator node.

summary.plain: The Leibstadt reactor building, where the CONUS+ detector runs about 21 m from the core, inside the plant's main building complex.
summary.technical: Dome-roofed reactor building (OSM building:part) identified by its roof and the plant's generator node; the surrounding main building complex is context; CONUS+ drawn as a derived point at the fitted reactor axis with 30 m accuracy (12.45 m horizontal offset from the axis is published, its azimuth is not).
